Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step (Analysis of Previous Result), the Planner incorrectly summarized the WebSurfer's findings. The WebSurfer had found that VMF-213 was assigned to the **USS Essex (CV-9)**, but the Planner's analysis explicitly stated: "The WebSurfer result indicates VMF-213 was assigned to the **USS Ranger (CV-4)**". This was a hallucination/error in reading or synthesizing the provided text. By introducing the incorrect carrier name (USS Ranger) based on a misinterpretation of the search results, the Planner set the entire subsequent investigation on the wrong path, causing the agents to waste time verifying a false lead (USS Ranger) instead of confirming the correct one (USS Essex) immediately.
